title: add-request-telemetry-json-access-logs-funccall-span-baggage
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Improve observability across the API surface for streaming, function/tool calls, and the OpenAI-compat shim by introducing a request-scoped telemetry header that carries tracing context and function-call baggage, emitting structured JSON access logs with fine-grained fields (route, model_family, mode, tokens_sent, tokens_received, tool_call_id, partial_stream_checkpoint), and tagging per-endpoint metrics with programmatic labels. This PR introduces: (1) middleware that injects and forwards an x-rw-telemetry header (traceparent+baggage) and preserves request IDs across proxy hops, (2) a lightweight func-call span bag that attaches tool call metadata to spans and is included in structured logs when tool/function calling occurs, (3) a JSON access log formatter that emits stable schema fields for downstream log pipelines, (4) metric label enrichment at the routing layer so per-endpoint counters and latency histograms include route_name, model_family, and request_mode (chat/completion/embedding), and (5) OpenAI-compat shim updates so clients using the shim automatically get propagated trace headers and per-chunk streaming checkpoint events logged. Backwards compatibility: the new middleware is opt-in via config flag `observability.request_scoped_telemetry=true` for Dedicated/Private until rollout completes; shown fallback behavior ensures older clients see no change. Testing and verification: unit tests for header propagation and JSON schema, integration test that validates streaming checkpoint logs under load, and a canary rollout plan (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%) with runtime toggle. Rollout notes and docs added to console/docs/observability.md. See files_changed and commits for details.

release_notes: Added opt-in request-scoped telemetry header (x-rw-telemetry) to propagate tracing and function-call baggage across proxies and the OpenAI compatibility shim.
Structured JSON access logs with stable schema fields for route, model_family, mode, tokens_sent/received, tool_call_id, and partial_stream_checkpoint.
Per-endpoint metric label enrichment (route_name, model_family, request_mode) with cardinality guards to limit overhead.
Canary rollout plan documented; feature is behind feature flag observability.request_scoped_telemetry for Dedicated/Private customers.
